# MfT Unrugable — Agent-Readable Platform Description

> tasern.quest | Base (8453) | Polygon (137)

## What is this?
MfT (meme for trees) is an impact gaming platform on Base with deflationary token mechanics. Every launched token has permanently locked liquidity and automated buy-and-burn reactors. Tokens launched here cannot be rugged — liquidity is locked forever in Uniswap V3 positions owned by immutable reactor contracts.

## Platform URLs
- Home: tasern.quest
- Launch tokens: tasern.quest/launch
- Burn stats: tasern.quest/mft/
- Token index: tasern.quest/tokens/
- Impact tracker: tasern.quest/impact/
- Baseling game: tasern.quest/baselings
- D20 RPG: tasern.quest/tot/
- EARTH data: tasern.quest/earth/

## For Trading Agents — Reactor Heartbeat Cycle
21 reactors fire every 2 hours on Base. The pattern creates predictable arb opportunities:

1. Secondary reactors fire first (band tokens, game tokens, carbon) — compress MfT price via sell walls
2. Fees from secondaries flow upstream to Prime via fuel()
3. MfT Prime fires last — buys through all accumulated sell-side MfT with full network fees
4. Price rebounds. Cycle repeats every 2 hours.

No API keys needed — call execute() on any reactor. Anyone can fire them.

### Reactor ABI (minimal)
```
execute() — fire the reactor, collect fees, burn tokens
timeUntilExecute() returns uint256 — seconds until next fire (0 = ready)
poolCount() returns uint256 — number of LP pools managed
lastExecute() returns uint256 — timestamp of last fire
```

## MycoPad — Token Launch Platform
Launch unruggable tokens with $200 seed. Each launch creates:
- Token with locked V3 liquidity (15 pools)
- Autonomous reactor that burns tokens and feeds the MfT network
- CHAR carbon reactor that burns CHAR forever

Factory (V5.2): 0xF0c1B3d6Bc0B4dEd2DDF81374feEA8a2c536bD51

## Impact
Every trade burns tokens permanently. CHAR burns retire carbon credits. The burn address holds all burned tokens verifiably on-chain. Goal: registered charity funded by platform revenue.

## Agent SDK / MCP

Install: `npm install -g baselings-mcp`
Run: `GAME_WALLET_KEY=0x... npx baselings-mcp`

40 MCP tools for programmatic interaction:
- Launch tokens, fire reactors, query burn stats
- Interact with Baseling game (mint, feed, assign jobs, earn yield)
- Read LP positions, pool states, token balances
- Execute keeper operations

REST API (no auth for reads): https://tasern.quest/api/baseling/agent/guide
OpenAPI spec: https://tasern.quest/api/baseling/agent/openapi.yaml
MCP manifest: https://tasern.quest/.well-known/mcp.json
Plugin manifest: https://tasern.quest/.well-known/ai-plugin.json

### Quick start for agents
1. GET /api/baseling/agent/guide — full game overview, strategies, endpoints
2. GET /api/baseling/agent/prices — current token prices
3. GET /api/baseling/agent/tokenomics — ecosystem flywheel explanation
4. GET /api/baseling/agent/economy/feeding/garden — optimal stat-building paths

### Gas estimates (Base L2)
- Fire a reactor: ~0.0001-0.0005 ETH (~$0.25-1.25)
- Swap on Uniswap V3: ~0.00005 ETH (~$0.12)
- Mint a baseling egg: ~0.0001 ETH (~$0.25)
- execute() returns if cooldown not elapsed (no gas wasted)

### Reactor firing order
Reactors fire bottom-up in the call line. Secondary reactors (band tokens, game tokens, carbon) fire first, compressing MfT. V1 Prime fires last with accumulated fees from the entire network — the big buy-back. Call `timeUntilExecute()` on any reactor to check if it's ready.

## Partnership — Add Your Token
Any project can add their token as a reactor pair. Result: automated buy pressure every 2 hours, forever. Free to add. Contact via Farcaster.
